name: io.github.vdeabreu/proton-mcp
title: Proton Mail
description: Read, search and send Proton Mail through Proton Mail Bridge, with sending kept on approval.

environmentVariables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_USER
environmentVariables.description: IMAP/SMTP username shown by Proton Mail Bridge

environmentVariables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: IMAP/SMTP password generated by Bridge (not your Proton password)

environmentVariables.name: PROTON_ENABLE_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to false for a strictly read-only server
